title: Gondomar: Corpus dixital de textos galegos da Idade Moderna
notes: The online corpus holds 84 texts up to 1791; this entry counts only the 31 texts dated 1594-1697. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: The footer reads '(c) 2017 Instituto da Lingua Galega'; no Creative Commons or other reuse licence was found on the home, texts and project pages (the corpus is on TEITOK and the TEI sample file I tried did not load), so the text is treated as copyrighted (checked 2026-10-13).
